candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show each checkout 502 paired with an order 500 within the same correlation ID.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, redis, payment) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway evidence consistently shows checkout 502s caused by order service 500s on /v1/orders within the same correlation IDs. The bounded candidate is http-500 at the order dependency; the deeper order-side cause is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order service metrics (db pool, redis, payment latency) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
